props.description: This creature act automatically at the end of each round.
props.name: Guest

props.animation_script:
// ============================================================================

// Skyfall Dive - Guest Dive (unified 5-phase cinematic)

// Shared skeleton (see PHASE banners in the client sub-script):

// PHASE 0 token -> webm stand-in

// PHASE 1 jump (home -> offscreen up)

// PHASE 2 wait (~1s hold at peak)

// PHASE 3 dive (top-right -> bottom-left onto impact)

// PHASE 3b impact FX (base always; bomb only if configured)

// PHASE 4 jump back (impact -> home) + restore token

// Differences are CFG-only: IMPACT_MODE (target|formation), BOMB_FX/BOMB_SFX.

// ============================================================================

(async () => {

const CFG = {

SCRIPT_ID: "oni.guestDive.skyfall",

SOURCE: "Skyfall Dive",

EVENT_TYPE: "skyfallDive",

BANNER_ENABLED: true, // move-name banner (part of the animation)

BANNER_TITLE: "Skyfall Dive", // banner text

BANNER_ICON: "\uD83D\uDCA5", // banner icon (skill)

BANNER_ACCENT: "#7fb5ff", // banner accent (blue)

BANNER_LEAD_MS: 500, // appear this long BEFORE motion (phase 0)

BANNER_HOLD_MS: 2000, // on-screen hold; total visible ~= 350+hold+400

CASTER_WEBM: "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Campaign/The%20Legend%20of%20Dragonslayer/Image/NPCs/Kalina/Kalina_Battler001.webm", // PHASE 0 stand-in sprite

IMPACT_MODE: "target", // single target center

BASE_FX: "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Impact/Impact_10_Regular_Orange_400x400.webm", // PHASE 3b base hit

BASE_FX_SCALE: 1,

BASE_SFX: "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Hit_SlashingB.wav",

BASE_SFX_VOL: 0.9,

BOMB_FX: "", // no bomb for Skyfall

BOMB_FX_SCALE: 2,

BOMB_SFX: "",

BOMB_SFX_VOL: 0.9,

PREP_SQUASH_RATIO: 0.8, // PHASE 0b crouch to 80% height

PREP_SQUASH_MS: 160, // squash down (fast-out)

PREP_HOLD_MS: 220, // hold the crouch

PREP_RELEASE_MS: 120, // spring back into the jump (ease-in)

JUMP_UP_MS: 220, // PHASE 1 (lower = faster launch)

PEAK_HOLD_MS: 700, // PHASE 2 (was 1000, -30%)

DIVE_MS: 170, // PHASE 3 (lower = faster dive)

LAND_HOLD_MS: 0, // PHASE 3c stay still after landing (0 = off)

JUMPBACK_MS: 400, // PHASE 4 arc duration (lower = faster arc)

JUMPBACK_APEX: 260, // arc peak height (px)

JUMPBACK_LAND_FRAC: 0.72, // fraction of the way home she lands; rest is slide

SLIDE_MS: 450, // PHASE 4b slide-back duration (higher = stronger ease-out)

OFFSCREEN_PADDING: 300,

DIVE_LATERAL_OFFSET: 600, // top-right start offset (px)

FORCE_SCALE_RATIO: 1.38,

FORCE_ANCHOR: { x: 0.5, y: 0.7 },

FORCE_FLIP_H: true, // fallback flip when FACE_TARGET off

FACE_TARGET: true, // auto-face the target side (L/R), held every phase

SPRITE_DEFAULT_FACES: "left", // which way the unflipped webm faces

SILHOUETTE: false, // no black tint on the sprite

AFTERIMAGE_COUNT: 5, // motion-trail ghosts (dive -> return)

AFTERIMAGE_LAG_MS: 20, // each ghost lags the one before it (ms)

AFTERIMAGE_ALPHA: 0.6, // ghost opacity

AFTERIMAGE_COLOR_NEAR: 0x3399FF, // nearest ghost tint (blue)

AFTERIMAGE_COLOR_FAR: 0x000000, // farthest ghost tint (black)

};

const TAG = '[ONI][Anim][SkyfallDive]';

function wait(ms){ return new Promise(function(r){ setTimeout(r, Math.max(0, ms)); }); }

globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI || {};

if (!ONI.emit){ ONI.emit = function(n,p,o){ p=p||{}; o=o||{}; if(o.local!==false) Hooks.callAll(n,p); if(o.world===true) game.socket.emit('world',{action:n,payload:p}); }; }

async function resolveTokenPlaceable(x){

if (!x) return null;

if (x.isToken) return x;

if (typeof x === 'string'){ try { var d = await fromUuid(x); if (d && d.object) return d.object; } catch(e){} return null; }

if (x.object && x.object.isToken) return x.object;

return null;

}

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD || {};

let caster = await resolveTokenPlaceable(P.casterTokenUuid || P.attackerUuid || P.sourceTokenUuid || null);

if (!caster) caster = (canvas.tokens.controlled && canvas.tokens.controlled[0]) || null;

let targetTokens = [];

const liveTargets = Array.from(game.user.targets || []);

if (liveTargets.length){ targetTokens = liveTargets; }

else {

const uuids = P.targetTokenUuids || P.targetUuids || P.targets || [];

for (const u of uuids){ const tk = await resolveTokenPlaceable(u); if (tk) targetTokens.push(tk); }

}

if (!caster){ ui.notifications.warn(TAG + ' No caster token.'); return; }

if (!targetTokens.length){ ui.notifications.warn(TAG + ' No target token(s).'); return; }

const targetIds = targetTokens.map(function(t){ return t.id; });

// ---- move-name banner: part of the animation. Fires BEFORE motion, self-expires. ----

if (CFG.BANNER_ENABLED) {

try {

const _api = window.FUCompanion && window.FUCompanion.api;

if (_api && _api.namecardBroadcast) {

_api.namecardBroadcast({ title: CFG.BANNER_TITLE, options: {

bg: '#000000', accent: CFG.BANNER_ACCENT, text: ['#ffffff', '#e9f2ff'],

glowColor: '#ffffff', border: 'rgba(255,255,255,.10)', dropShadow: '0 10px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.35)',

maskEdges: true, edgeFade: 0.12,

showIcon: !!CFG.BANNER_ICON, iconOverride: CFG.BANNER_ICON, iconScale: 0.93, iconGapPx: 10,

xAlign: 'center', offsetX: 0, offsetY: 64, fixedWidth: 640, autoWidth: false, cardScale: 1.0,

inMs: 350, holdMs: CFG.BANNER_HOLD_MS, outMs: 400, enterFrom: 'left',

maxFontPx: 30, minFontPx: 16, letterSpacing: 0.06, fontWeight: 700, upperCase: false,

fontFamily: 'Pixel Operator, system-ui, sans-serif', textStrokePx: 0.1, textStrokeColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)',

baselineVh: 900, scaleMin: 0.75, scaleMax: 1.75, scaleMode: 'vh',

} }); // NOT awaited: the banner runs its own in/hold/out timer regardless of the motion

}

} catch(e){ console.warn(TAG, 'banner failed', e); }

}

if (CFG.BANNER_LEAD_MS > 0) await wait(CFG.BANNER_LEAD_MS); // banner leads the motion

ONI.emit('oni:animationStart', { type: CFG.EVENT_TYPE, sourceTokenId: caster.id, targetTokenIds: targetIds, sceneId: canvas.scene ? canvas.scene.id : null, timestamp: Date.now() }, { local:true, world:false });

// Remedy - Guest heal cinematic. Banner + a healing sparkle on the crisis ally.

// Sequencer auto-broadcasts to all clients; no pseudo.play needed. Heal number

// lands at HEAL_BLOOM_MS (item timing_offset). animationEnd = seq end, so the

// round waits for it (see firePreAcceptedCandidate pendingAnimations).

// ============================================================================

(async () => {

const CFG = {

BANNER_ENABLED: true, // move-name banner

BANNER_TITLE: "Remedy", // banner text

BANNER_LEAD_MS: 400, // appear this long before the sparkle

HEAL_TINT: "#9dff8f", // green tint; empty string = original yellow

FADE_IN_MS: 150,

FADE_OUT_MS: 300,

HEAL_SFX: "", // optional sound (empty = none)

HEAL_SFX_VOL: 0.8,

HEAL_BLOOM_MS: 350, // heal number lands here (item timing_offset)

};

const TAG = '[ONI][Anim][Remedy]';

function wait(ms){ return new Promise(function(r){ setTimeout(r, Math.max(0, ms)); }); }

globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI || {};

if (!ONI.emit){ ONI.emit = function(n,p,o){ p=p||{}; o=o||{}; if(o.local!==false) Hooks.callAll(n,p); if(o.world===true) game.socket.emit('world',{action:n,payload:p}); }; }

async function resolveTokenPlaceable(x){

if (!x) return null;

if (x.isToken) return x;

if (typeof x === 'string'){ try { var d = await fromUuid(x); if (d && d.object) return d.object; } catch(e){} return null; }

if (x.object && x.object.isToken) return x.object;

return null;

}

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD || {};

let caster = await resolveTokenPlaceable(P.casterTokenUuid || P.sourceTokenUuid || null);

if (!caster) caster = (canvas.tokens.controlled && canvas.tokens.controlled[0]) || null;

let targetTokens = [];

const liveTargets = Array.from(game.user.targets || []);

if (liveTargets.length){ targetTokens = liveTargets; }

else {

const uuids = P.targetTokenUuids || P.targetUuids || P.targets || [];

for (const u of uuids){ const tk = await resolveTokenPlaceable(u); if (tk) targetTokens.push(tk); }

}

if (!targetTokens.length && caster) targetTokens = [caster];

if (!targetTokens.length){ ui.notifications.warn(TAG + ' No target.'); return; }

const targetIds = targetTokens.map(function(t){ return t.id; });

// ---- banner (fire-and-forget, self-expiring) ----

if (CFG.BANNER_ENABLED) {

try {

const _api = window.FUCompanion && window.FUCompanion.api;

if (_api && _api.namecardBroadcast) {

_api.namecardBroadcast({ title: CFG.BANNER_TITLE, options: {

bg: '#000000', accent: CFG.BANNER_ACCENT, text: ['#ffffff', '#e9ffe9'],

glowColor: '#ffffff', border: 'rgba(255,255,255,.10)', dropShadow: '0 10px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.35)',

maskEdges: true, edgeFade: 0.12,

showIcon: !!CFG.BANNER_ICON, iconOverride: CFG.BANNER_ICON, iconScale: 0.93, iconGapPx: 10,

xAlign: 'center', offsetX: 0, offsetY: 64, fixedWidth: 640, autoWidth: false, cardScale: 1.0,

inMs: 350, holdMs: CFG.BANNER_HOLD_MS, outMs: 400, enterFrom: 'left',

maxFontPx: 30, minFontPx: 16, letterSpacing: 0.06, fontWeight: 700, upperCase: false,

try {

if (game.modules.get('sequencer') && game.modules.get('sequencer').active){

const seq = new Sequence();

for (const t of targetTokens){

let e = seq.effect().file(CFG.HEAL_VFX).atLocation(t).scaleToObject(CFG.HEAL_SCALE).fadeIn(CFG.FADE_IN_MS).fadeOut(CFG.FADE_OUT_MS).belowTokens(false);

}

})();
